notes.title: Assassin update with fixes and difficulty lowered
notes.notes:
Updated the game with a number of fixes as well as making the difficulty level much easier.

In this month, the android version will release too on the Play Store and also a web version :)

notes.title: Update with changes
notes.notes:
Made several changes and improvements to the game:

- replacing the coins with orbs to make it feel more fitting to the game style
- Fix the camera when assassination with neck cracking.
- certain level fixes with difficulty and flooring problems.

That's it :)

notes.title: Release in July
notes.notes:
Legend of the Assassin KAL is releasing soon in July.

It's a game that has been in the making for more than 2 years on and off in between projects.

Add it to your wishlist it if you haven't!
